How It Works

Three steps from idea to playable game.

1

✍️ Describe Your Game

Write a few sentences about the game you want. Genre, mechanics, art style — whatever you imagine.

2

⚡ We Build It

Our AI plans the architecture, generates art, writes GDScript, and compiles everything in Godot 4.

3

🎮 Play & Learn

Get a compiled executable and the full Godot source. Play it, study the code, then make it even better.

What Is Inside Your Game

Every generated game comes with real, editable source code you can learn from.

🎨 Custom Art Assets

AI-generated sprites, textures, and backgrounds that match your game's visual style.

💻 Real Game Code

Complete GDScript you can read and learn from — player movement, enemies, scoring, and more.

🌐 UI & Menus

Title screens, HUD, health bars, and score displays — all properly structured in Godot scenes.

🛠 Scene Architecture

Properly organized Godot project with correct node hierarchies you can study and extend.

🎬 Input Handling

Keyboard and controller mappings pre-configured for your game's mechanics.

🚀 Playable Build

A compiled Windows .exe ready to share with friends — no engine installation needed to play.

Common Questions

Is the first game really free?

Yes. Verify your phone number and generate one complete game at no cost. No credit card required. Same quality, same output as paid games.

Can I edit the game after?

Absolutely! You receive the complete Godot project. Open it in the Godot editor and modify anything — that is the whole idea. Build on what CircuitBot gives you.

How long does generation take?

Most games are ready in 15-30 minutes, depending on complexity.

What engine is used?

Godot 4 — open source, no license fees, huge learning community. You get the full source project to learn from.

Do I need to know how to code?

Not at all! CircuitBot generates the game for you. But if you want to learn, you will have real working code to study and experiment with.

What if generation fails?

If we cannot produce a working game, you will receive a full refund. No questions asked.

Now It Is Your Turn!

Your generated game is a real Godot 4 project — not a black box. Open it up, explore the code, tweak things, break things, and learn by doing. That is how every great game developer starts.
